description: Send mailboxes' login credentials (SMTP/IMAP) to the user's third-party sequencer account (Instantly or Smartlead, from list_sequencers) so it can send from them. Omit mailboxes to export all eligible ones. Requires confirm=true after the user explicitly agrees. Large exports answer status pending and finish on the server; list_sequencers shows the counts.

confirm.description: Must be true, after the user agreed to share the credentials with this sequencer.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Optional: defaults to the workspace picked at sign-in or bound to the API key.

name: export_mailboxes_to_sequencer

next_step.description: What to do next, in one sentence.

status.description: pending: the export continues on the server; check list_sequencers after next_check_after_seconds.

title: Export mailboxes to a sequencer
